title_en: Artificial Intelligence (13/20): The AI Customer Service Agent
note_en: 答不清楚 "can't answer clearly" is a potential complement: verb + 不 + result, saying the action can't reach its result. Its positive form uses 得: 答得上来 "able to come up with an answer." The text is full of them: 说不清楚, 说不明白, 回答不出. English needs "can't" plus an adverb or extra verb, while Chinese tucks the ability straight into the verb phrase.
